newsitem.title: EU: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, June 9 - Sunday, June 15.
newsitem.headline: EC Report Weekly Diary for Monday, June 9 - Sunday, June 15.

text.p: (page 1/2 - Monday-Tuesday)
HIGHLIGHTS
LUXEMBOURG - EU finance ministers meet (Mon); discussions focus on European Monetary Union and annual meeting with the European Investment Bank in the evening.
LUXEMBOURG - Signature of the mutual assistance customs protocol between Switzerland and the EU (Mon).
STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (Mon-Fri); statements by the Council and European Commission on the Amsterdam European Council (Weds).
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer holds n/conf on the Amsteram European Council (Weds).
STRASBOURG - European Commission regular meeting (Tues).
STRASBOURG - European People's Party holds summit (Tues); participants debate the enlargement of NATO and the inter-governmental conference.

BRUSSELS - EU Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (Weds-Thurs). European Commissioner Wulf-Mathies gives address on the outcome of the informal council meeting on territorial planning (Thurs).
LUXEMBOURG - EU social affairs ministers meet (Thurs).
MONDAY, JUNE 9

LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU finance ministers meet (0900/0700 GMT). Agenda includes: third stage of European Monetary Union (EMU); implementation of broad economic guidelines for 1996 and draft guidelines for 1997; convergence programme for Ireland; SEM 2000; protection of the Community's financial interests and fight against fraud; employment; derogations from excise duties on mineral oils; preparation for Luxembourg presidency. Annual meeting with European Investment Bank (2100/1900 GMT).
LUXEMBOURG - Signature of the mutual assistance customs protocol between Switzerland and the EU (1100/0900 GMT).
STRASBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Parliament holds plenary session (1700/1500 GMT) (to Fri). Agenda includes: television broadcasting activities; public health.
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Research Committee meets - European Commissioner Papoutsis attends.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds conference on "What future for social protection in Europe? - The German example" (1400/1200 GMT) (and Tues). European Commissioner Flynn attends. Venue: ECOSOC. Contact: ECOSOC (322) 546 9207.
BRUSSELS - European Automotive Industry holds conference on "Automotive News Europe" (1400/1200 GMT) (and Tues). Venue: Sheraton Hotel and Towers. Contact: Julia Moulton (44) 1705 631 331.

PRAGUE - The Adam Smith Institute holds conference on "The future of air transport in Central Europe and Baltic States - Airlines, airports and air traffic services" (and Tues). Speakers include: DG VII Head of Unit Frederick Sorensen. Venue: The Inter-Continental Hotel. Contact: Business Seminars International Ltd (44) 171 490 3774.
TUESDAY, JUNE 10
BRUSSELS (MODIFIED ITEM) - EU Monetary Committee meeting HAS BEEN CANCELLED.
STRASBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Commission regular meeting (1500/1300 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- Green paper on additionnal pensions in the internal market.
- Interim report on the implementation of regional employment pacts.
- Role of learning in job creation.
- Liberalisation of the telecoms market.
- Proposal for regulation on air schedules.
- Commission President Santer on the labelling of products containing or derived from genetically modified organisms.

STRASBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - European People's Party (EPP) holds summit (1700/1500 GMT). Agenda includes: the debate on the enlargement of NATO and the inter-governmental conference (IGC). Participants include: EPP President Wilfried Martens, German Chancellor Helmut Kohl, Irish Prime Minister John Bruton, Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene, Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes, Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and European Commission President Santer. Venue: Palais de l'Europe. Contact: Konstantin Ivanov (322) 284 2507.

STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament holds plenary session (0900/0700 GMT) (second of five days). Agenda includes: European Monetary Union (EMU) and VAT; open network provisions in the telecoms sector; transport of combined goods.
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil Robles meets European Monetary Institute President Alexandre Lamfalussy (1300/1100 GMT).

STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Committee on BSE meets - European Commissioner Oreja gives address on opinions given to the inter-governmental conference (IGC) on legal aspects of consumer protection (1000/0800 GMT).
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Economic Committee meets - European Commissioner Monti gives address on the single market action plan.
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament Research/Energy Committee - European Commissioner Papoutsis gives address on the outcome of May 27 Energy Council, followed by an exchange of views.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "Competition issues in completing the single market" (1315/1115 GMT). Speaker is: London Economics Director Tom Hoehn. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

LONDON - Agra Europe holds first European cheese conference (and Weds). Venue: The Waldorf Meridien Hotel. Contact: Agra Europe (44) 1892 511807. 061320 DED:BC-DIARY-WEEKLY =2 Reuter EC Report Weekly Diary (page 2/2 - Wednesday-Sunday)
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 11

STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament holds plenary session (0900/0700 GMT) (third of five days). Agenda includes statements by the Council and European Commission on the Amsterdam European Council; fight against fraud; relations between China and the EU; equal pay for men and women.
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer holds n/conf on the Amsteram European Council (1200/1000 GMT).

BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (1700/1500 GMT) (and Thurs). Agenda includes: climate change; renewable energy sources; innovation for Europe; waste disposal.
THURSDAY, JUNE 12

LUXEMBOURG (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU social affairs ministers meet (1000/0800 GMT). Agenda includes burden of proof in sex discrimination cases, workers' protection against cancer agents at work, interim report on employment, modernising and improving social protection, European sustems of worker involvement, worker consultation, social dialogue.

STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament holds plenary session (1000/0800 GMT) (fourth of five days). Agenda includes: European voluntary service for young people; education; humane trapping standards for fur-bearing animals.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - EU Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (0900/0700 GMT). European Commissioner Wulf-Mathies gives address on the outcome of the informal council meeting on territorial planning. Agenda includes: INTERREG II; green paper on trade; free movement of goods; promotion of sustainable mobility; green paper on vertical restraints; implementation of Community law in environment; European voluntary service for youth.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Association of European Airlines (AEA) holds n/conf to present it's yearbook 1997 (1100/0900 GMT). Venue: 350 avenue Louise. Contact: AEA (322) 627 0600.

BRUSSELS - Berlin, Stockholm and Vienna host meeting on "Berlin, Stockholm, Vienna - The gateway to Central and Eastern Europe" (1030/0830 GMT). Venue: Kredietbank, avenue du Port 2. Contact: Kredietbank (322) 738 0070.
MILAN, Italy - Euromanagement holds conference on "Managing the future growth of cogeneration in Europe" (and Fri). Contact: Euromanagement (31) 40 2974 944.
FRIDAY, JUNE 13
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Parliament holds plenary session (0900/0700 GMT) (last of five days). Agenda includes: human rights; EU-Bulgaria agreement.
SATURDAY, JUNE 14
No events scheduled.
SUNDAY, JUNE 15
No events scheduled.
